headline: Diesel could rise by 85 bani from 1 October. How much a litre could cost in Ploiești
summary: Standard diesel in Romania could rise by 85 bani a litre from 1 October, as Wednesday is the last day it benefits from a 25% excise reduction set by the Ministry of Finance.
why: Fuel excise taxes directly set pump prices, affecting consumer inflation, transport costs and the budget revenue the state collects from fuel.

original_headline: Motorina s-ar putea scumpi cu 85 de bani de la 1 octombrie. Cât ar putea costa litrul în Ploiești
